summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, an incremental update to Opus 4.7 with benchmark improvements, a cheaper/faster mode, and new agentic and workflow features, at unchanged base pricing.

mechanisms.reason: Fast mode pricing for Opus 4.8 was cut to a third of its prior cost while running faster.
mechanisms.quote: fast mode for Opus 4.8—where the model can work at 2.5\u00d7 the speed—is now three times cheaper than it was for previous models

mechanisms.reason: New dynamic workflows feature lets Claude run large numbers of parallel subagents to complete big multi-step tasks autonomously.
mechanisms.quote: Claude can plan the work and then run hundreds of parallel subagents in a single session (and with Opus 4.8, the agents can run for even longer)

mechanisms.reason: The lab itself characterises the release as a modest capability improvement rather than a step change.
mechanisms.quote: Users will find Opus 4.8 to be a modest but tangible improvement on its predecessor.
